children: Innovative Industrial Properties entered into an underwriting agreement to issue 2,000,000 shares of its 9.25% Series B Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock at $25.00 per share, for gross proceeds of $50 million. Stifel is acting as representative of the underwriters, who also have a 30-day option to purchase up to 300,000 additional shares. Net proceeds are expected to be approximately $48.4 million before expenses, with closing anticipated on or about October 19, 2026. The offering is being made under the company's shelf registration filed with the SEC.
